openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; record household-name discrepancies and update behind-desk exceptions whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Verified addresses reduce second searches; persistent delays during the burst favor congestion.
openings.probe: Bounded clerk trial records address correctness, second searches, queues, preparation and reconciliation time; verify claimant before handoff.
openings.uncertainty: Mismatch causality, service-time updating and an adequate verification procedure are unconfirmed; retrieval benefit is untested.

openings.claim: New arrivals may retrieve faster from the cart; the stipulated sample challenges universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: A comparable-cohort advantage supports cart retention; disappearance with volume or size supports selection bias.
openings.probe: Observe natural cart and shelf pickups, recording arrival volume, book size, correctness and time; unmatched comparisons remain inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Cohort comparability, cart capacity and routine retention remain unproven.

openings.claim: Future private per-hold addresses could replace surname retrieval; test rejecting obsolete reports using increasing book-specific movement versions.
openings.discriminator: Shuffled duplicate reports distinguish greatest-version from last-received ledgers; ordered-report success is insufficient.
openings.probe: Ten-minute closed-desk paper simulation: six anonymous holds move among existing shelves/cart; compare ledgers against scripted final positions, recording errors and time; no handoffs.
openings.uncertainty: Live opaque identifiers, detection, private lookup, trusted sequencing and claimant verification are unconfirmed. Versions cannot repair undetected or misassigned moves; live workload remains untested.

decision: Run bounded probes with the existing clerk, two shelves, one cart and paper; keep names/contact details behind desk and daily preparation within ten clerk-minutes. Fits cover probes only. All evidence is synthetic; none establishes 95% of available pickups within two minutes or zero wrong-reader handoffs. Interview representativeness is unknown.
